title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Accountant Job 2066 views Q. Are My Earnings Halal, And Is My Job Legitimate In Light Of Islam 5301 views Q. If I get loan for business against my property, which is government supported loan which gives me subsidy and less interest, even I have to pay lesser amount than my loan amount. 1878 views Q. During my tenure with an organization I happened to get some money which I later found out was Haraam. What i did is that when i was absent i would get my attendance signed for me by my friend and thus prevent any deductions being made from my salary on account of leave. Later I found that this money is not halaal for me. So I havent used that money and kept it aside. Please guide me as to what I should do with that money. I asked a local mufti and he said that I should return the money anyhow to the company. But I am not sure how can this be done. As I no longer work for the company, I am in a big dilemma with this money. Please guide me on this issue and what should be done with the money. I really want to get rid of this money as early as possible and in the most shariah compliant way Jazakallah. 1552 views Q. What are the methods of family planning permissable in Islam? can we use condom during intercourse for family planning? 5046 views Q. The numbers of Qadyanis (mirzai) are getting higher in our office. At the time of interview they do not disclose their religion and as per official policy we cannot investigate religion 2220 views Q. I would like to know that if a person commits haram will he be expelled from islam. 2399 views Q. My sperm quality is not up to the mark as per medical report. shall i go for medical method like Invitro Fertilization to have child. In this method they use my spem and put in my wife overy after fertilization. Doctor is a women. 2858 views Q. Question: 9353 I would like to bring to your attention to FATWA 9353. It is said that one should avoid renting the land to the banks, for the rent will be paid with the interest money. My question is a person working in a company, which is operating its business through loan obtained from bank, is the salary taken by the person from the company halaal or haraam? 2061 views Q. I am registered pharmacist according to Maharashtra pharmacy council 2918 views Q. I am a married person and have no issue and it is to submit you that the sister of my wife is ready to conceive with my sperm through medical facilities who is also married to give me a child. pl, inform it is right or not. 2499 views Q. I am a PhD Student in a reputed research institute from India. The sole niyyat of my doing PhD is daawat/tashkeel/kasb-e-halaal in the institute. Once in 6 months I need to go in a conference and present a paper in a conference hall or auditorium. I have a beard with fist length and I am always in long loose kurta and shalwar above ankles. When I am on the stage, the photographers treat me similar to all the audience and take a photo/video of mine or they take my photo whenever I ask questions during the discussion. They do this for non-muslims too. I totally dislike that someone take my photo, because thats haraam as per my knowledge. So my respected muftyaan-e-ikraam is it permissible for a practising muslim to wear a thin helmet (with face cover) and goto such places? If the audience laugh seeing a practising Muslim in helmet, is then wearing the helmet permissible in shariat? I feel my niyaat of daawat/tashkeel and my muaamlaat demand that I should go there but shariat prohibits photography so how shall I maintain taqwa in this issue? Is the question clear ? Hoping for an earliest reply. 2390 views Q. کیا ہم گھر میں ڈکیٹی کے خوف سے گھر کی حفاظت کے لئے ( ہاؤس گارڈ ) کتے رکھ سکتے ہیں؟ 1398 views Q. An allopathy doctor advised me to take heart surgery*bypass* according to islam can i take that surgical treatment or should go to an unani doctor? Kindly tell me quickly as i am in an emergency medical ward... 2262 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 51640 Country: India Title: Silver ring for gents Question: Is it permissible for a Muslim male to wear a silver ring with a stone studded on his hand? Answer ID: 51640 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 674/558/B=05/1435) If the weight of the silver is less than one mithqal (4.5 masha) then one may wear the ring studded with stone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
